Yes — as a US passport holder, you need a visa for Vietnam. The United States has no visa-free exemption (bilateral or unilateral) with Vietnam, so you'll need to get an e-Visa before you travel.

Key details for your 2-week trip:
- The e-Visa covers stays of up to 90 days, so your 14 days is well within the limit.
- Cost: $25 for single-entry or $50 for multiple-entry.
- Apply online at https://evisa.gov.vn/; processing typically takes 2-3 business days (expedited options are available for a higher fee).
- It's valid for entry/exit by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports.
- Make sure your passport is valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

This is based on policy data current as of 2026-08-17 — I'd recommend double-checking the latest requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you book, since immigration rules can change.
